description: Add an alpha channel (Channels panel > New Channel) whose colour shows masked or selected areas, or a spot colour channel (New Spot Channel) with its ink colour and solidity; optionally filled from the selection (Save Selection as Channel)

color.description: Overlay colour of an alpha channel, or ink colour of a spot channel. "#RRGGBB", "rgb(r,g,b)" (0-255), "cmyk(c,m,y,k)" (0-100), "gray(g)" (0-100, 100 = black), "hsb(h,s,b)" (0-360, 0-100, 0-100) or "lab(L,a,b)"

fromSelection.description: Fill the channel from the current selection. Default false

name.description: Channel name; spot channels are usually named after the ink

opacity.description: Overlay opacity of an alpha channel, or Solidity of a spot channel, percent

name: create_channel
title: Create Channel
